<function name="SetDrivingEntity" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
<internal></internal>
Sets the driving entity and driving mode.

Use <page>drive.PlayerStartDriving</page> instead, see <page>Entity Driving</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="drivingEntity" type="Entity" default="NULL">The entity the player should drive.</arg>
		<arg name="drivingMode" type="number">The driving mode index.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
